title: Japanese Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese-inspired skillet dish featuring American sausage and served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: 1. Preheat the skillet in the oven for 5 minutes.
2. Add oil to the preheated skillet and swirl to coat.
3. Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add your favorite steamed vegetables (e.g. broccoli, bell peppers) and cook until tender.
5. Garnish with crumbly and serve immediately.
